prompt_text: How much does nonprofit donor CRM cost
response_text:
### Nonprofit Donor CRM Pricing Overview (2026) Nonprofit donor CRMs vary widely in cost based on factors like **number of contacts/records**, **number of users**, **features/modules** (e.g., donor management, events, reporting, automation), and **billing model** (monthly/annual, tiered, or usage-based). "Free" options often rely on donor tips or platform fees (2-3%), which can hurt donor experience. Paid plans start as low as **$45/month** for basics and scale to **$500+/month** for all-in-one systems. Most offer nonprofit discounts, unlimited users on many plans, and trials. #### Key Pricing Ranges | Category | Starting Price (Monthly, Billed Annually) | Examples & Notes | |----------|-------------------------------------------|------------------| | **Budget/Lightweight** (Core donor tracking, small lists <2,500 contacts) | $45–$125 | - Little Green Light: $45 (up to 2,500 records); $90 for 20,000.
- Bloomerang: $125 (up to 1,000 records; unlimited users).
- DonorPerfect: $99 (record-based; add-ons extra). | | **Mid-Tier** (Growing orgs, 1K–10K contacts, emails/automation) | $125–$300 | - Keela: ~$225 (2,500 contacts; unlimited users/emails).
- Givebutter Plus: $29+ (scales by contacts; core free w/ donor tips or 3% fee).
- DonorDock: $125 (up to 1,000 records; fundraising add-on $40). | | **Enterprise/All-in-One** (Events, P2P, advanced reporting; 10K+ contacts) | $300–$700+ | - CharityEngine: $500 (unlimited contacts).
- Virtuous: ~$300 (custom; AI insights).
- Giveffect: $399–$599 (modules for volunteers/events). | | **Free/Low-Cost Entry** | $0 (w/ fees) | - Givebutter Core: $0 (3% fee if no tips).
- Open-source: $0 software, but high setup time. | #### Pricing Drivers (From Sources) - **Contacts/Records**: Primary scaler (e.g., Bloomerang/DonorPerfect charge per record tier). - **Users**: Per-user rare; most unlimited (e.g., Bloomerang, Keela). - **Add-Ons**: Events/auctions/volunteers extra (e.g., DonorDock volunteer mgmt $119). - **Transaction Fees**: 1.75–3% on donations if not covered by tips/subscriptions. - **Discounts**: 10% annual billing common; some free licenses (e.g., DonorDock: 10 free for eligibles). #### Top Recommendations by Org Size - **Small (<1K contacts)**: Little Green Light ($45) or Givebutter (free tier). - **Mid-Sized (1K–10K)**: Bloomerang ($125) or Keela ($225) for retention tools. - **Large/Complex**: CharityEngine ($500) or DonorPerfect ($99+) for scalability. Prices from 2026 sources like DonorDock, Bloomerang, and CharityEngine blogs; always check vendor sites for custom quotes/trials, as they scale with needs. For ROI, factor in time savings and donor retention gains (e.g., Bloomerang emphasizes 20–30% retention boosts).
